mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% over the prior month reduces discount rates, lowering the present value of future earnings and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5% from the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns turn positive despite sustained FEDFUNDS rise, with p-value < 0.05 in a two-tailed test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (labor market tightness) above 160,000 monthly signals labor scarcity that raises wage growth expectations, stimulating equity valuations and producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Payrolls remain below 160,000 for 3 consecutive months with no change in SPX 60d returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 quarterly demand index above 24,000 indicates excess demand that accelerates corporate investment and drives positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by 2,000 from prior quarter
failure_condition: GDPC1 remains flat or declines while SPX 5d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO index below 103 suggests soft supply conditions that reduce production costs and improve margins, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns when triggered.
failure_condition: INDPRO stays above 103 for 4 consecutive months with no SPX 20d up-movement.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.25% and UNRATE falls below 4%, the dual signals of higher policy rates and declining labor costs create a risk-off environment that drives negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain positive despite sustained policy tightening and falling unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in HOUST (housing starts) above 1,500 units suggests rebuilding momentum in the housing market, which correlates with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: HOUST growth stalls while SPX 60d returns show no statistically significant improvement.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 2024 Q1 averages indicate excess demand in both consumer and business sectors, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns remain negative despite both indicators staying above thresholds for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE stays above 5% for two consecutive months in a low-inflation regime, the expectation of tighter labor markets raises wage costs, compressing corporate profits and yielding negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns turn positive when UNRATE falls below 5% for 3 months.
